atoms.b: All plants can be divided into two categories. Those with ((++seeds hands)) and those without.
((++All Some)) plants have the ability to reproduce, but the process is different depending on whether they produce seeds or not.
Seeds are the small, ((++hard soft)) parts of plants from which a new plant grows.
Seeds are produced when male and female cells in the plant combine during a process called ((++fertilisation seedisation)).
Plants that don’t produce seeds like ferns, mosses and algae reproduce by releasing ((++spores chemicals)).
Unlike seeds, spores are reproductive cells and fertilisation occurs away from the parent plant, often in a ((++damp dry)) place.

instruction.text: Are these plants with or without seeds? Sort them into the correct groups?

hint.text: Plants with flowers or fruit have seeds.
